instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/job_input.step in FreeCAD Path/CAM. Use FreeCAD with the Path/CAM modules. Complete a FreeCAD Path/CAM Job containing Pocket, Drilling, and Profile operations. Tool definitions: use an end mill for pockets, a drill for holes, and a profile end mill for outside contours. Write the required output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-06.nc. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH).
